info.title: AquaTome accounts and saved tanks
info.description:
Optional accounts for "Bể của tôi": sign in (Apple, Google, email code, or a passkey added to the account), sync saved tanks between the site and the iOS app, export and delete the account.

Records and merge rules: docs/my-tanks-sync.md; schemas: protocols/tanks.schema.json; cases: protocols/tanks-vectors.json.

Off unless the server has ACCOUNTS=on (or preview, for the owner): then GET /api/v1/session says {"accounts": false} and every other path is 404 accounts_off.

Every POST body is JSON with Content-Type: application/json. Changes from a browser must come from https://aquatome.com pages (Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site); the app sends no Origin and no cookie, and authenticates with Authorization: Bearer <token>. A bearer token is only valid as a bearer token, a cookie only as a cookie.

Errors are {"error": "<code>"} with the status listed. 429 rate_limited can come from any sign-in path.

bearer.description: The app: the token from a sign-in with client "app".

cookie.name: __Host-aq_session
cookie.description: The site: set by a sign-in with client "web".

User.description: An account holds no name, email address or phone number.

token.description: client "app" only, and only for a new session: send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Keep it in the Keychain.

refused.description: Records sent that did not validate: not stored; keep them on the device.

get.summary: Whether accounts are on, which sign-ins to offer, and who is signed in

200.description: Off: {"accounts": false}. On: providers and the signed-in user (null when signed out). A browser's cookie is renewed.

google.description: The web client id (the app uses its own, also accepted).

apple.description: The Services ID for the web; the app uses its bundle id.

passkey.description: Passkeys are on (PASSKEYS=on): offer "sign in with a passkey" and, signed in, "add a passkey".

post.summary: A one-time nonce (10 minutes) to put in the Apple or Google sign-in request

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

200.description: The nonce. Web: pass it as is. Sign in with Apple on iOS: set request.nonce to its SHA-256 (lowercase hex) and send the nonce itself below.

post.summary: Sign in with Apple: the provider's ID token
post.description: The identity token from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential (iOS, audience = the bundle id) or Sign in with Apple JS (web, audience = the Services ID). The authorization code is not used here (only when deleting the account).

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

link.description: true: add this sign-in method to the account signed in on this client (its session goes on; no new token). Without it, signing in while signed in switches to the account this method belongs to and ends the old session: accounts are never joined unless asked.

200.description: Signed in. Web: Set-Cookie __Host-aq_session (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; 180 days, renewed when used). App: `token` (365 days, renewed when used). With link: true, the method was added to the signed-in account (no new session, no token).

401.description: Error: bad_token, bad_nonce, signed_out (link without a session)

409.description: Error: credential_in_use (link: this sign-in belongs to another account), apple_already_linked (link: the account has another Apple ID; one per account)

post.summary: Sign in with Google: the provider's ID token
post.description: The ID token (credential) from Google Identity Services (web) or Google Sign-In (iOS), whose audience is one of our client ids.

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

link.description: true: add this sign-in method to the account signed in on this client (its session goes on; no new token). Without it, signing in while signed in switches to the account this method belongs to and ends the old session: accounts are never joined unless asked.

200.description: Signed in. Web: Set-Cookie __Host-aq_session (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; 180 days, renewed when used). App: `token` (365 days, renewed when used). With link: true, the method was added to the signed-in account (no new session, no token).

401.description: Error: bad_token, bad_nonce, signed_out (link without a session)

409.description: Error: credential_in_use (link: this sign-in belongs to another account)

post.summary: Email a 6-digit sign-in code (15 minutes, once)
post.description: Needs a Cloudflare Turnstile token for the site key in /api/v1/session. The reply's `flow` is a secret only this browser or app may hold: keep it (web: localStorage, so a link opened in another tab of the same browser works; app: memory) and never put it in a URL. For a browser, the mail holds the code and a link https://aquatome.com/<language page>#ma=<code> (vi: /vi/cong-cu/be-cua-toi/, id: /id/alat/akuarium-saya/, th: /th/tools/my-tanks/), which the page fills in. With client: "app", the mail holds the code alone and says to type it into the app. The app gets its Turnstile token from GET /api/v1/auth/email/turnstile. With link: true (signed in), the address is added to that account. The address is not stored. Limits: 3 codes an hour per address, 10 an hour per network.

link.description: true: add this sign-in method to the account signed in on this client (its session goes on; no new token). Without it, signing in while signed in switches to the account this method belongs to and ends the old session: accounts are never joined unless asked.

post.summary: Sign in with the emailed code and the flow secret from /email/start
post.description: Wrong codes count: after 5, or 15 minutes, or once used, the flow is gone (401 bad_code; ask again). A flow started with link: true only works for that same account, signed in on this client, and adds the address to it; any other flow signs in (ending any other session on this client).

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

200.description: Signed in. Web: Set-Cookie __Host-aq_session (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; 180 days, renewed when used). App: `token` (365 days, renewed when used). With link: true, the method was added to the signed-in account (no new session, no token).

401.description: Error: bad_code (wrong, used, expired, too many tries, or started by another account)

get.summary: The Turnstile check alone, as a web page for the app's email sign-in
get.description: Turnstile runs only in a web page, and its token is checked against this site's host, so the app opens this page in a web view (WKWebView with a script message handler named `turnstile`; keep the web view's user agent the same throughout). The page posts {"token": "…"} when solved, {"expired": true} when that token runs out, and {"error": "…"} when the check fails; calling `again()` in the page gives a new token (each is used once, by POST /api/v1/auth/email/start). No other page may frame it. 503 provider_off when email sign-in is off.

post.summary: A challenge to sign in with a passkey
post.description: Any passkey of this site the device holds (discoverable credentials: no allowCredentials). User verification required. The challenge is valid 5 minutes, once. The relying party is aquatome.com; the app uses it through its webcredentials association (/.well-known/apple-app-site-association).

schema.description: WebAuthn options as JSON (@simplewebauthn/server; navigator.credentials.get/create via PublicKeyCredential.parse*OptionsFromJSON, or ASAuthorization on iOS).

503.description: Error: provider_off (passkeys are not on, or this is not the site's own host)

post.description: The signed answer to a challenge from /auth/passkey/options. Only a passkey added to an account (POST /api/v1/account/passkey) signs in; a passkey the server does not know, a wrong signature, origin or relying party, no user verification, a used or expired challenge, or a signature counter that goes back are all 401 bad_passkey. Signs in like the other methods (ending any other session on this client).

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

200.description: Signed in, as for the other methods.

503.description: Error: provider_off (passkeys are not on, or this is not the site's own host)

post.summary: End this session (the token or cookie stops working); signed out already is fine

client.description: "app": the reply carries a bearer token and sets no cookie (send no Origin header and no cookie). "web": an HttpOnly session cookie; the request must come from the site's own pages.

204.description: Signed out; the browser's cookie is cleared. The device keeps its own copy of the tanks.

get.summary: The account's saved tanks and devices, tombstones included

post.summary: Merge the device's records into the account's; the account's store after the merge
post.description: Send every record (or every record changed since the last sync) as a TankStore; each is checked on its own and merged by docs/my-tanks-sync.md (an updatedAt ahead of the server's clock becomes the server's). Take the returned store as the device's, keeping refused records and records changed since the request was sent. Signing in: sync the device's whole store once, so local tanks join the account. Up to 2000 records a request; 600 syncs an hour; one at a time per account (409 busy: try again shortly). The server stores a tombstone as its three keys only, and keeps the newest 1000 tombstones of each kind.

400.description: Error: bad_store (not v1, or not lists), bad_request

422.description: Error: too_many (the account would hold more than 200 live tanks, 400 live devices, or 1 MB of live records)

get.summary: Everything the account holds, as a JSON file

delete.summary: Delete the account now: its tanks, sign-in methods and every session
delete.description:
Ask the reader to confirm first. The device keeps its own copy of the tanks unless the reader clears it too.

An account with Sign in with Apple: Apple requires its tokens to be revoked, and none are kept, so first ask the reader to sign in with Apple again and send that `authorizationCode` here (the app: ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential.authorizationCode, clientId = the bundle id; the web: Sign in with Apple JS, clientId = the Services ID, redirectUri = the page's address as given to AppleID.auth.init). Without it the answer is 409 apple_reauth.

code.description: A fresh authorization code (valid 5 minutes, once).

redirectUri.description: Web only: exactly the tanks page the code was asked from (as given to AppleID.auth.init).

204.description: Deleted (Apple tokens revoked first); the browser's cookie is cleared.

400.description: Error: bad_request (clientId not ours), bad_redirect (redirectUri is not a tanks page)

409.description: Error: apple_reauth (send a fresh Apple authorization code), apple_other_account (the code is for another Apple ID: nothing revoked)

429.description: Error: rate_limited (10 Apple tries an hour per account)

502.description: Error: apple_revoke_failed (Apple refused the code or the revoke: ask again)

delete.summary: Remove a sign-in method (not the last one)
delete.description: Removing a Sign in with Apple method takes the same fresh Apple authorization code as deleting the account (see DELETE /api/v1/account): its tokens are revoked first.

code.description: A fresh authorization code (valid 5 minutes, once).

redirectUri.description: Web only: exactly the tanks page the code was asked from (as given to AppleID.auth.init).

400.description: Error: bad_request (clientId not ours), bad_redirect (redirectUri is not a tanks page)

429.description: Error: rate_limited (10 Apple tries an hour per account)

502.description: Error: apple_revoke_failed (Apple refused the code or the revoke: ask again)

post.summary: A challenge to add a passkey to the account signed in
post.description: Registration options for this account: resident key and user verification required, no attestation, ES256 or RS256, and the account's passkeys as excludeCredentials. The user handle is the account id; the name shown in passkey managers is "AquaTome" and the start of that random id. Valid 5 minutes, once, for this account only. 20 per hour per account (with POST /api/v1/account/passkey).

schema.description: WebAuthn options as JSON (@simplewebauthn/server; navigator.credentials.get/create via PublicKeyCredential.parse*OptionsFromJSON, or ASAuthorization on iOS).

503.description: Error: provider_off (passkeys are not on, or this is not the site's own host)

post.summary: Add a passkey to the account signed in
post.description: The new passkey, made from options this account asked for. Kept: its credential id, public key, signature counter and transports (no attestation, nothing biometric). After this, the passkey signs in to this account on its own.

200.description: Added. The account, with the passkey among its methods.

400.description: Error: bad_request, bad_passkey (not this account's challenge, used or expired, or the answer does not verify)

503.description: Error: provider_off (passkeys are not on, or this is not the site's own host)
